interface.longDescription:
Dukaan connects you to kirana shops that deliver to your address. Ask for what you need in your own words, and it finds the shops near you that actually stock it, with their prices.

With Dukaan in ChatGPT you can:
Order groceries and household items from a shop near you.
Compare prices across the shops that deliver to your address.
Track an order, or cancel it before the shop accepts.
Save a delivery address once and reuse it in any chat.
Pay cash on delivery.

The assistant reads back the items, the total and the full address before it places anything. Sign in happens on Dukaan's own page, so your password is never shared.
capabilities: Find shops that deliver to your address
Track or cancel an order before the shop accepts
defaultPrompt: Order 2 packs of soap from the nearest shop
Find a kirana with Amul milk in stock tonight
What can I order for 200 rupees near me
Where is my last order right now
Cancel my order before the shop accepts it

positive.description: Order an item from a nearby shop
positive.prompt: Order 2 packs of soap from the nearest shop
positive.expected_behavior: Finds shops that stock soap near the delivery address, shows the shop, prices, total and full address, and places the order only after an explicit yes.

positive.prompt: What can I order for 200 rupees near me
positive.expected_behavior: Lists items within the budget with their prices, without inventing products or prices.

positive.prompt: Where is my last order right now
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the order status and shop for the signed-in account.

positive.prompt: Cancel my order before the shop accepts it
positive.expected_behavior: Cancels the order if the shop has not accepted it, otherwise explains that the shop must be called.

positive.prompt: Deliver to 29, infront of hospital, Sambhar 303604
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the address exactly as typed, uses the location captured at sign-in as the delivery pin, and reads the address back before ordering.

negative.expected_behavior: Explains that payment is cash on delivery and that the plugin cannot transfer money.
Reports that no nearby shop stocks it and orders nothing.
Refuses. Only the signed-in account's addresses and orders are readable.

review.commerce_description: Physical goods only. Payment is cash on delivery, collected by the shop. The plugin does not process payments, sell digital goods, or offer subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: First public release: nearby shop and product search, saved addresses, quote and confirm, cash on delivery.
